chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

He said: 'O Jabir! When it is the Day of Resurrection, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will gather the first and the last for the Decisive Speech. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) will be called, and the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) will be called. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) will be clothed in a green garment that illuminates what is between the East and the West, and Ali (peace be upon him) will be clothed with the like of it. And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) will be clothed in a rosy garment that illuminates what is between the East and the West, and Ali (peace be upon him) will be clothed with the like of it. Then they will both ascend wearing them.'

Then we will be called, and the accounting of the people will be handed over to us. By Allah, we are the ones who will make the people of Paradise enter Paradise and the people of Fire enter Fire. Then the Prophets (peace be upon them) will be called, and they will stand in two rows near the Throne of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, until we finish with the accounting of the people.

So when the people of Paradise enter Paradise and the people of Fire enter Fire, the Lord of Glory will send Ali (peace be upon him), and he will place them in their stations in Paradise and marry them. For Ali, by Allah, is the one who marries the people of Paradise in Paradise. And that is not for anyone other than him, as a honor from Allah, whose memory is exalted, and a favor which Allah has preferred him with and bestowed upon him. And he, by Allah, is the one who makes the people of Fire enter Fire, and he is the one who closes the doors upon the people of Paradise when they enter it, because the doors of Paradise are under his control and the doors of Fire are under his control.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of Imam Ali on the Day of Judgment according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the concept of *Tawassul* through the Ahl al-Bayt, portraying Imam Ali (AS) not merely as a successor but as the active agent of divine administration on the Day of Judgment. The narration emphasizes his exclusive authority in assigning final abodes and orchestrating the marriages of Paradise's inhabitants, a role derived from Allah's special favor (*Fadl*) bestowed upon him. This elevates the Imam's status from a passive intercessor to a co-executor of the final divine decree alongside the Prophet.
